notes.decision: Fits with guardrails. /workspace/rescue/intake stays the single intake home. The admission form, the per-animal checklist, hold release and the readiness verification are added to that page; no new route, navigation layer, dashboard or status narrator is introduced.
notes.persona: A shelter operator or intake volunteer admits an arriving animal, records what has been checked, and needs to know in plain words why the animal is not yet adoptable.
notes.reuse: The existing RescueCockpit shell, Surface, StatusBadge, shared form primitives (TextField, SelectField, TextareaField, SubmitButton, FormStatus) and the canonical Resource/occupancy read model are extended. Housing options come from the Ward board; the readiness explanation comes from the one placement-readiness evaluator.
notes.sourceTruth: AnimalProfile owns identity; AnimalCustodyEpisode and AnimalCustodyEvent own custody, stage and hold; CareIntakePacket owns the frozen checklist; CareRecord owns typed evidence; ResourceCapacityAllocation owns housing. Readiness is a projection over those records and is never stored as a flag.
notes.states: No open housing disables admission and names the recovery (add or unblock a unit). Every blocker is rendered as a sentence, never by color alone. Release hold appears only on a held animal; Verify placement readiness appears only when the evaluator is satisfied. Shared FormStatus exposes pending, success, validation, permission, capacity and stale-version outcomes; every control is at least 44px high.
notes.aiBoundary: No control sends a coworker prompt. Every action is a direct governed server command with server-derived organization, storefront, housing kinds and acting principal.
notes.verification: Focused policy, readiness, repository, workspace-loader and component tests plus web typecheck passed. Browser verification on the governed contributor preview is recorded in the PR body; if the preview could not be leased the PR says so and the UX check is reported as unrun, not passed.
